response.sql:
WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        link_to_major as major_id,
        COUNT(*) as member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) as total_members,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_major) FROM member) as num_majors
)
SELECT 
    gc.major_id,
    gc.member_count,
    gc.member_count * 1.0 / s.total_members as share_of_total,
    gc.member_count * 1.0 / (s.total_members * 1.0 / s.num_majors) as count_vs_avg
FROM group_counts gc
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY count_vs_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Members with NULL link_to_major are included as their own group; the average group count is calculated as total_members / count_of_distinct_link_to_major_values (including NULL as one value)

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude members with no major assignment (NULL link_to_major) from all counts and group calculations

    SELECT 
        link_to_major as major_id,
        COUNT(*) as member_count

),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) as total_members,

)

    gc.major_id,
    gc.member_count,
    gc.member_count * 1.0 / s.total_members as share_of_total,
    gc.member_count * 1.0 / (s.total_members * 1.0 / s.num_majors) as count_vs_avg
FROM group_counts gc
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY count_vs_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
